messages.title: Trying document loaders
messages.content: Hi team, has anyone tried the new LangChain document loaders?

messages.title: How TextLoader works
messages.content: Yes, TextLoader returns one Document for the whole file.

messages.title: How CSVLoader works
messages.content: CSVLoader is different: it gives you one Document per row.

messages.title: Next up: JSONLoader
messages.content: Next I want to try JSONLoader with a jq schema like .messages[].content.
